# EvDropdownMenuItem

> One row of a DropdownMenu: an action, a destructive action, a group heading, or the rule between two groups.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:dropdown-menu-item` |
| Layer | Atom (`src/atoms`) |
| Import | `import { EvDropdownMenuItem } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvDropdownMenuItem>` or `<ev-dropdown-menu-item>` |
| Source | `src/atoms/dropdown-menu-item/EvDropdownMenuItem.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<li class="ev-dropdown-menu-item--separator">` |
| Used inside | `evoq-ui:dropdown-menu` (EvDropdownMenu) |

## Example

```vue
<EvDropdownMenuItem
  label="Ganti nama"
  subtext="Ctrl R"
>
  <template #kbd>
    <EvKbd>R</EvKbd>
  </template>
</EvDropdownMenuItem>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Dropdown Menu**, frame `4262:77736` (Dropdown Menu). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Group related actions or commands behind a single trigger — row actions, overflow (⋯) menus, contextual commands, or account menus.

### When not to use

- To pick a value in a form → use a Dropdown List / Select. For primary page navigation → use a Nav, not an action menu.

### Do

- Order actions by frequency or group them with dividers. Add search for long menus. Use scroll affordances when the menu exceeds the viewport.

### Don't

- Don't mix destructive and routine actions without separation. Don't nest deep submenus. Don't exceed what fits without scroll.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvDropdownMenuItem`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<li class="ev-dropdown-menu-item--separator">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:dropdown-menu-item` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
